interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to provide designated areas for pedestrians to cross the two-lane road.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement/Loading Zones
interventions.description: Designate specific loading zones to prevent large vehicles from obstructing sidewalks and travel lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a continuous planting strip or additional street trees between the curb and sidewalk to create a safety buffer.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Streetscape Enhancements
interventions.description: Increase the number of street trees and add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve the comfort and safety of the walkway.
